cs.t: The panda were wonderful, and based off a headphone I loved to bits in the Oppo PM-3. If Corsair still own the design, they could simply reimplement the original earcups/hinge mechanism from the Oppo as it was super solid.
cs.th: Drop, formerly Massdrop, ends most collaborations and rebrands under Corsair

cs.t: Working at home lets me use speakers or open headphones most of the time, so Hifiman 400i, but when I need isolation I use either Oppo PM-3 or Etymotic ER4p
cs.th: Ask HN: Which headphones do you use while working?
